answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy works like a reef: its strength comes from slow, costly deposits that fakes cannot shortcut. Identity is built from stake, graded-work history, and peer attestations — expensive to create and slow to accumulate, so mass-producing accounts is pointless. New agents get low weight during a bonding period; established peers only attest to accounts they have actually graded. Attestations act like a velvet rope, soft but real, and slashing plus per-epoch caps make every sockpuppet emit a weak signal that honest consensus simply filters out.
